title: Owner: watch Misato and a consultant think on the dashboard
goal: The owner sees a named, timed thinking state appear and disappear on the dashboard
acceptance: On NERV-01 after the update, open the dashboard (http://127.0.0.1:<port> as usual) and keep the Pilots panel and the sorties visible. In chat type: `pianifica una cena per sabato con tre ospiti`. Expected while NERV works: the consultant's pilot card shows its name, Consultant, its model and the sortie ID, with a time that counts up, and the sortie shows the same wording as its line; when Misato plans, her state appears the same way. Expected after the answer: the marks disappear and the EVA cages line still says how many EVA jobs are active (0 if none ran), never counting the thinking
Second check: in a terminal run `nerv service restart` while a long answer is thinking. Expected: the thinking mark is gone within a few seconds of the dashboard reconnecting, not stuck
Report what you see (or a screenshot) in chat; the agent records the result in the record's Verification
privacy: Neutral invented pilots, sorties and models only; no owner data or tokens in Git, tests or logs.
validation: Owner check, recorded in F-148 Verification
escalation: The owner decides whether the display is enough; the agent records the result

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: two short checks on the Mac. Not a measurement.
